title: Notice to the complainant.
bodyText: After a reasonable time has elapsed, the ombudsman shall notify the complainant of the actions taken by the ombudsman and by the agency.
bodyHtml: §96-14  Notice to the complainant.  After a reasonable time has elapsed, the ombudsman shall notify the complainant of the actions taken by the ombudsman and by the agency. [L 1967, c 306, §15; HRS §96-14; gen ch 1985]
